project: iOS Settings Clone, IMEI Checker, Admin Panel
theme: hybrid (iOS native simulation + modern web admin)

typography.font_family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

ios_simulation.container: w-full max-w-[430px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#F2F2F7] sm:border sm:border-gray-200 sm:shadow-2xl sm:rounded-[40px] sm:my-8 overflow-hidden relative
ios_simulation.header: h-[44px] flex items-center justify-between px-4 bg-[#F2F2F7]/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-[#C6C6C8]/50

admin_dashboard.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-900 text-white min-h-screen p-4 flex flex-col gap-2

public_imei_checker.container: min-h-screen bg-gray-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4
public_imei_checker.card: w-full max-w-md bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-8

components.ios_list_row: flex items-center justify-between min-h-[44px] pl-4 pr-4 py-2.5 relative cursor-pointer active:bg-[#D1D1D6]/50 transition-colors
components.ios_list_separator: absolute bottom-0 left-[54px] right-0 h-[0.5px] bg-[#C6C6C8]
components.ios_icon_container: w-[28px] h-[28px] rounded-[7px] flex items-center justify-center text-white shrink-0 mr-4

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Write React components using .js or .jsx extensions, NOT .tsx.

For the iOS Simulation: strictly adhere to the exact hex codes provided for colors. Do not use generic Tailwind grays (like gray-100) for the iOS UI; use exact arbitrary values like bg-[#F2F2F7] and bg-[#FFFFFF].

The iOS list separators must not span the entire width. They should be offset from the left by exactly the width of the icon plus padding (e.g., left-[54px]). Use absolute positioning for the separator at the bottom of the row. Do NOT show a separator on the last item of a group.
For icons matching Apple's SF Symbols, use 'lucide-react' (with strokeWidth={1.5}) or 'react-icons/io5'.
For the Admin Panel: Use Shadcn UI components (Table, Input, Button, Dialog) heavily customized with Tailwind. Keep it professional, high-density, and clean.
Data bindings: Ensure the 'About' page data maps exactly to state/props so it can be dynamically populated from the API.
Routing: Split the app logically. e.g., `/settings` for the simulation, `/admin` for the admin login/dashboard, `/` for the public IMEI page.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
